name: Automated Job Application & Cover Letter Agent
description: Scrapes LinkedIn hiring posts daily, filters them for genuine fit, writes a tailored application email with an LLM and sends it with a resume attached. Set credentials and the CANDIDATE PROFILE blocks before activating.

parameters.text:
=You are an expert email copywriter for job applications. Write a unique, professional job application email.

**Job Post:** {{ $json.postContent }}

**Job Title:** {{ $json.jobTitle }}
**Experience the post asks for:** {{ $json.expLabel }}

## CANDIDATE PROFILE - the ONLY source of facts about the applicant:

* Name: Likhitha Samala
* Total experience: 3.9 years (write it as "nearly 4 years" or "around 4 years", never a different number)
* Core skills: Python, AI/ML, Generative AI, LLMs, RAG applications, Flask, n8n automation
* Portfolio: https://likhitha-portfolio-neon.vercel.app/

## TRUTH RULES - these override every other instruction below:

* State the years of experience in the opening paragraph. Recruiters screen on it first.
* Only name a technology if it appears in BOTH the candidate profile AND the job post.
* If the post asks for a technology the candidate does not have, do NOT mention that
  technology and do NOT claim familiarity with it. Lead with the overlapping skills instead.
* Never invent employers, project names, metrics, certifications, notice periods or salary figures.
* Never claim more than 3.9 years of experience, even if the post asks for more.


## YOUR TASK:

Create an original job application email that feels natural and personalized, NOT like a template.

## MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS:

**SUBJECT LINE:**

* Must include the job title from the post
* Keep it simple and professional (6-10 words max)
* Variations you can use: "Applying for...", "Application for...", "Interested in...", "[Job Title] - Application", etc.
* DO NOT include skills or technologies in subject

**BODY STRUCTURE:**

1. **Greeting:** Use one of: Hey / Hello / Hi / Hi there

2. **Opening paragraph:**

   * Mention where you saw the job (LinkedIn)
   * Reference the job title
   * State nearly 4 years of experience explicitly
   * Mention ONLY the skills shared by the candidate profile and this job post
   * Express genuine interest and fit for the role
   * Keep it 2-3 sentences maximum

3. **Portfolio section:**

   * Mention the portfolio naturally after the opening paragraph.
   * Use one of the following variations:
     * "You can also explore some of my work here: https://likhitha-portfolio-neon.vercel.app/"
     * "For additional details about my projects, please visit my portfolio: https://likhitha-portfolio-neon.vercel.app/"
     * "I've also included my portfolio below for your reference: https://likhitha-portfolio-neon.vercel.app/"
     * "My portfolio showcasing selected projects can be viewed here: https://likhitha-portfolio-neon.vercel.app/"
   * Keep it to one sentence only.
   * DO NOT mention LinkedIn profile.

4. **Resume section:**

   * DO NOT include any resume link
   * Mention the attached resume naturally using phrases like:
     * "Please find my resume attached for review."
     * "I've attached my resume for your consideration."
     * "My resume is attached for your reference."

5. **Closing:**

   * Keep it short and professional
   * Use natural sign-offs like:
     * "Best regards"
     * "Thanks & regards"
     * "Looking forward to hearing from you"
     * "Sincerely"
   * Add name:
     Likhitha Samala

## CRITICAL FORMATTING RULES:

**YOU MUST USE PROPER LINE BREAKS:**

* Between greeting and opening paragraph: Use "\n\n"
* Between opening paragraph and portfolio section: Use "\n\n"
* Between portfolio section and resume section: Use "\n\n"
* Between resume section and closing: Use "\n\n"
* Between closing and name: Use "\n"

## EXAMPLE FORMAT:

Hi there\n\nI came across your AI Engineer opening on LinkedIn and found the role closely aligned with my experience in Python, Machine Learning, and Generative AI applications. I’m very interested in contributing to AI-driven projects and backend development opportunities.\n\nYou can also explore some of my work here: https://likhitha-portfolio-neon.vercel.app/\n\nPlease find my resume attached for your review.\n\nBest regards\nLikhitha Samala

## VARIETY INSTRUCTIONS:

* Vary wording naturally in every email
* Avoid repetitive sentence structures
* Make the email feel human-written and concise
* Use a friendly but professional tone
* Keep the email between 100-160 words

## OUTPUT FORMAT:

Return ONLY valid JSON (no markdown, no code blocks, no explanations):

{
  "subject": "[generated subject]",
  "body": "[generated email body with proper \\n\\n and \\n spacing]"
}

## IMPORTANT:

1. NO resume link in the email.
2. Mention the resume is ATTACHED.
3. Include the portfolio link naturally after the opening paragraph:
   https://likhitha-portfolio-neon.vercel.app/
4. DO NOT mention LinkedIn profile.
5. Use proper line breaks exactly as instructed.
6. Keep it personalized and professional.
7. Return ONLY the JSON object.

attributes.name: jobType
attributes.description: Analyze the job post content and classify it into exactly ONE category: "AI" for AI/ML/Data Science/Automation jobs, "Development" for web development/WordPress/full-stack/frontend/backend jobs, or "Other" if it doesn't clearly match AI or Development. Return only the word: AI, Development, or Other.

options.systemPromptTemplate:
You are a job classification expert. Analyze the job description and classify it into ONE category:

**AI Category:**
- Machine Learning, Deep Learning, AI/ML Engineer
- Data Science, Data Analyst, ML Engineer
- NLP, LLM, GPT-related roles
- AI Automation, AI Developer
- Computer Vision, Neural Networks
- TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn

**Development Category:**
- Web Developer, Full Stack Developer
- WordPress Developer, PHP Developer
- Frontend Developer (React, Vue, Angular)
- Backend Developer (Node.js, Django, etc.)
- MERN/MEAN Stack
- Software Engineer, Software Developer

**Other Category:**
- Jobs that don't clearly fit AI or Development
- Mixed roles without clear focus
- Non-tech positions

Return ONLY one word: AI, Development, or Other

attributes.name: gmail id
attributes.description: The email address that applications should be sent to, exactly as written in the post. Empty string if the post contains no email address.

options.systemPromptTemplate:
You extract the application email address from a LinkedIn hiring post.

RULES:
1. Return the address a candidate is told to send their CV or application to.
2. Prefer an address appearing near words like apply, send, share, CV, resume, careers, hiring, hr, jobs, recruitment.
3. If several addresses appear, return the single most likely application address.
4. Return ONLY the raw address, lowercase, with no name, no mailto:, no angle brackets and no surrounding text.
5. If the post contains NO email address, return an empty string. Never invent, guess, complete or correct an address.
